EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT – FICTIONAL SAMPLE

Position: Remote Data Manager
Employer: Intl. Data Solutions (address not provided)
Salary: 4,500 EUR/month for 2 hours daily

Required before starting:
- Work equipment (laptop): 890 EUR
- Training fee: 250 EUR
- Background check: 150 EUR

Costs will be "reimbursed after the first salary payment."
First salary paid after 60 days.
No termination rights for the first 6 months.

Signature: HR Manager (WhatsApp only)
